insights: Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos, averaging over 1,000 views compared to double-digit views for long-form content.

The 'Shocking fact first' and 'Myth vs fact' styles yield the highest average view percentages and scores for shorts, notably seen in videos like NASA Artemis III (113.5% retention) and Maglev Trains (88.91% retention).
Early drop-offs consistently occur between the 4-second and 8-second mark across multiple shorts, indicating that hook pacing needs tighter editing in the first 5 seconds.
Videos covering aerospace, rockets, and orbital mechanics (e.g., Artemis III, Satellites) drive higher engagement and likes than general computing or AI topics.
Call-to-action questions at the end of shorts are currently failing to drive comments, as nearly all shorts recorded zero or one comment.
Long-form exploratory videos suffer from low initial click-through and severe audience drop-off past the 15-second mark, with retention falling below 30%.
